articles.summary: Mar. 21, 2026- Omeros Corporation (NASDAQ: OMER) today announced that it will host an industry session at the 52 nd Annual Meeting of the European Society for Blood and Marrow Transplantation (EBMT ) on March 22, 2026 , from 2:30pm - 4pm CET in Madrid, Spain . The session, titled “Advances in TA-TMA Treatment: Evaluating the Role of a Novel Targeted Therapy,” will be co-chaired by Rafael Duarte , MD, PhD, Hospital Universitario Puerta de Hierro Majadahonda, and Mohamad Mohty, MD, PhD, Hôpital Saint-Antoine, AP-HP, and will feature speakers Miguel-Angel Perales , MD, Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center , and Michelle L. Schoettler , MD, MS, Children’s Healthcare of Atlanta . The EBMT Annual Meeting is a key event for professionals in transplantation and cellular therapy, bringing together stakeholders from around the world.
